newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish printing house sets issue price at PLN 7.5.
newsitem.headline: Polish printing house sets issue price at PLN 7.5.

text.p: Polish printing house Poligrafia SA set the issue price of its 1,357,280 public offering at 7.5 zlotys per share, the company said in its prospectus.
The shares will be offered ex-rights with the large-investors' 857,280-share tranche due from October 28 to October 31 and the 500,000-share retail tranche due from October 21 to October 25.

The firm, which seeks parallel market's listing said it expected its net profit to rise to two million zlotys this year and to 2.8 million zlotys in 1997, up from last year's net of 0.8 million zlotys.
Poligrafia's main shareholders are construction firm Exbud SA, which holds 88.76 percent of the firm's shareholder votes and a subsidiary of The Fleming Poland Fund Ltd which has 9.99 percent.
